lessons: The fence is missing files the change forces. clutch/author.py:452 and clutch/rework.py:196 call review_ticket, and the ticket requires both to move to review_with_identity. Tests outside the fence monkeypatch module.review_ticket, so they break once the import goes.

Add to the Scope fence: tests/integration/test_author.py (lines 180, 215), tests/unit/test_author.py:143, tests/unit/test_author_roadmap_row.py:184, tests/unit/test_author_stem_claimed.py:48 and tests/unit/test_key_scope.py:174. Each one patches author/rework review_ticket and must patch

Do not keep an unused review_ticket import in author.py or rework.py so the old patches still resolve. The ticket forbids parallel legacy paths, and the wrapper calls requisition.review_ticket, so those patches would silently stop intercepting the call.

Class fix: when a ticket migrates a call site, its author must grep for monkeypatch.setattr(<module>, "<name>") across tests/ and fence every match. Today these five files were found only at Implement, which cost an attempt.
